name: @toros/adapters-desktop
description: T3 read-only Windows UIA desktop discovery adapter — deskop.state + desktop.inspect
_comment_entrypoints: tsconfig sets rootDir '.' so that src/ and test/ both compile, which puts the emitted entrypoint at dist/src/index.js — not dist/index.js. These paths must match that layout or every consumer fails with TS2307 'Cannot find module @toros/adapters-desktop'.
